description: Works to trees covered by LBE ORDER NO (128) 1981: 5x Lime - Prune overhanging branches back to neighbours fence by up to 3m.
decision_conditions: This consent is valid for two years.Reason: In order that the nature of work pertaining to this consent remains appropriate.

The works hereby approved shall only be carried out strictly in accordance with British Standard 3998 [2010] 'Tree Works' and shall not exceed the boundary line. The works shall only be carried out to young, lateral branches and shall not exceed any previous pruning points. Cutting into larger diameter, older branches is not permitted.Reason: In the interests of the health, safety and appearance of the preserved trees.

Tree work should not be carried out during periods that are likely to interfere with or disturb breeding birds or mammals.Reason: In order to comply with the requirements of the Wildlife and Countryside Act (1981) and Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations (2010).
